_meta.note: Proposed automatically by intake triage for unsupported devices / unknown DPs while the native fix is investigated. Never a reason to skip the native fix.

paths.title: Read/write any Tuya DP from a flow
paths.applies: Zigbee 0xEF00 and Wi-Fi local devices of this app
paths.reply: While we add native support: use the flow cards 'Tuya DP received (any device)' to see which DP changes, and 'Send Tuya DP (any device)' to drive it.

paths.title: Turn an unknown DP into a normal capability
paths.applies: standard Homey capabilities only (measure_*, meter_*, alarm_*, onoff, dim, target_temperature, windowcoverings_set, volume_set); read-only display
paths.reply: Run once the flow card 'Map Tuya DPs to capabilities' with e.g. 101:measure_temperature:10 and the value appears on the device (plus Insights).

paths.title: Raw Zigbee command / attribute write
paths.reply: Expert option: 'Send raw Zigbee (ZCL) command' or 'Write Zigbee attribute' with the cluster/attribute from Zigbee2MQTT.

paths.title: Tuya cloud tap-to-run scene
settings: tuya_cloud_access_id / tuya_cloud_access_secret / tuya_cloud_region (own Tuya IoT project)
paths.applies: any device visible in Smart Life; needs the user's own Tuya IoT cloud project (free trial, renewable); optional
paths.reply: Last resort for a device we cannot drive yet: create a tap-to-run scene in Smart Life and start it with 'Run a Tuya cloud scene (opt-in)' after enabling it in the app settings.

paths.title: Dimmer range squeezed or repeating
paths.reply: If 0-100 % in Smart Life fits in a third of the Homey slider, set 'Brightness scale' to 0-255 in the device settings (auto-detection also learns it after one full-range change).
